title: Wiggles & Giggles
description: Wiggles & Giggles Wiggles and Giggles Storytime @ Lumpkin Lumpkin County Library Branch Tuesdays from 11:00 - 11:45 am Get ready to wiggle, giggle, and grow! This program is designed for toddlers who are confident walkers–35 months , along with their parent(s) or caregiver(s). We’ll build early literacy skills through songs, action rhymes, books, movement, and play. It’s a wonderful opportunity for toddlers to explore, hear lots of language, and have fun while connecting with their caregivers and other little ones! title: Dahlonega Woman's Club Meeting
description: Dahlonega Woman's Club Meeting Dahlonega Woman's Club Meetings All women of Dahlonega/Lumpkin County are welcome to join Dahlonega Woman's Club, a charitable service organization of women dedicated to strengthening the Dahlonega/Lumpkin County community and enriching lives through volunteer service and fundraising. The club meets at the historic Community House, 111 N. Park Street, Dahlonega, on the first Thursday of every month, except July and December.
